motion.name: button-transition
motion.purpose: Brief button state changes; omitted easing uses CSS ease.

motion.name: busy-spin
motion.purpose: Work-in-progress icon; spin ends at rotate(360deg).

motion.name: status-pulse
motion.purpose: Generating status dot; midpoint opacity is .35.

components.name: Primary button
components.css: .ds-button-primary{font-family:var(--font, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Arial, sans-serif);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:38px;padding:8px 13px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:background .14s,border-color .14s;background:var(--blue, #0053fd);border-color:var(--blue, #0053fd);color:#fff;}.ds-button-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:#0043d3;border-color:#0043d3;}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue, #0053fd);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-button-primary:disabled{opacity:.43;cursor:not-allowed;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-primary{transition-duration:.01ms;}}

components.name: Secondary button
components.css: .ds-button-secondary{font-family:var(--font, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Arial, sans-serif);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:38px;padding:8px 13px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:background .14s,border-color .14s;background:#fff;border-color:#cbdcfb;color:var(--blue, #0053fd);}.ds-button-secondary:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--blue-faint, #eef4ff);border-color:#9ebcfa;}.ds-button-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue, #0053fd);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-button-secondary:disabled{opacity:.43;cursor:not-allowed;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-secondary{transition-duration:.01ms;}}

components.name: Quiet button
components.css: .ds-button-quiet{font-family:var(--font, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Arial, sans-serif);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:38px;padding:8px 13px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:background .14s,border-color .14s;background:none;color:var(--muted, #5b6b83);}.ds-button-quiet:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--hover, #e8effb);color:var(--ink, #1b263b);}.ds-button-quiet:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue, #0053fd);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-button-quiet:disabled{opacity:.43;cursor:not-allowed;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-quiet{transition-duration:.01ms;}}

components.name: Text action
components.css: .ds-text{font-family:var(--font, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Arial, sans-serif);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;background:none;border:0;color:var(--blue, #0053fd);padding:5px 0;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;}.ds-text:hover:not(:disabled){text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px;}.ds-text:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue, #0053fd);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-text:disabled{opacity:.43;cursor:not-allowed;}

components.name: Icon action
components.description: Compact named icon control, shown as close.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-icon" aria-label="Close"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12"/></svg></button>

components.name: Text field
components.description: Canonical labeled field with the actual focus and disabled states.
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-field">Local model address</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-field" placeholder="http://localhost:11434" />
components.css: .ds-field-label{font-family:var(--font, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Arial, sans-serif);display:block;color:#526079;font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;font-weight:500;margin-bottom:9px;}.ds-field{font-family:var(--font, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Arial, sans-serif);width:100%;padding:10px 12px;color:var(--ink, #1b263b);border:1px solid var(--line-strong, #d5dfef);background:#fff;border-radius:6px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;outline:none;}.ds-field::placeholder{color:var(--muted, #5b6b83);opacity:1;}.ds-field:focus,.ds-field:focus-visible{border-color:var(--blue, #0053fd);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--blue-faint, #eef4ff);}.ds-field:disabled{background:var(--paper, #f8faff);}

components.name: Sidebar navigation
components.description: Flat navigation rows with selection and keyboard focus.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="Workspace"><button type="button" class="ds-nav-item ds-nav-selected" aria-current="page">Conversations</button><button type="button" class="ds-nav-item">Daily priorities</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;background:var(--sidebar, #f3f7ff);}.ds-nav-item{font-family:var(--font, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Arial, sans-serif);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:41px;border:0;border-radius:5px;padding:10px 11px;text-align:left;background:none;color:#364660;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5;cursor:pointer;}.ds-nav-item:hover{background:var(--hover, #e8effb);}.ds-nav-selected{color:var(--blue, #0053fd);background:#e8f0ff;}.ds-nav-item:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue, #0053fd);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Run badge
components.description: Informational queued status; content in this specimen is illustrative.
components.html: Queued

components.name: Artifact row
components.description: Compact clickable evidence container; the filename is specimen content.
components.css: .ds-artifact{font-family:var(--font, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Arial, sans-serif);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line, #e3eaf5);padding:10px 12px;border-radius:5px;text-align:left;color:#7386a3;background:none;cursor:pointer;line-height:1.5;}.ds-artifact>span{flex:1;min-width:0;}.ds-artifact strong{display:block;font-size:11px;font-weight:500;color:#445671;overflow-wrap:anywhere;}.ds-artifact small{display:block;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted, #5b6b83);margin-top:3px;}.ds-artifact:hover{border-color:#bcd2f8;background:var(--paper, #f8faff);}.ds-artifact:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue, #0053fd);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Conversation composer
components.description: Signature multiline surface; disabled send reflects the empty specimen.
components.css: .ds-composer{font-family:var(--font, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Arial, sans-serif);border:1px solid #cbdaf5;border-radius:11px;background:#fff;padding:12px 12px 9px;box-shadow:0 2px 5px #10316706;}.ds-composer:focus-within{border-color:#91b4ff;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #0053fd08;}.ds-compose-input{font-family:var(--font, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Arial, sans-serif);display:block;width:100%;border:none;border-radius:0;box-shadow:none;padding:4px 3px 9px;min-height:55px;height:60px;max-height:180px;resize:vertical;font-size:13px;line-height:1.65;background:#fff;color:var(--ink, #1b263b);outline:none;}.ds-compose-input::placeholder{color:var(--muted, #5b6b83);opacity:1;}.ds-compose-toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;justify-content:space-between;min-height:34px;}.ds-model{font-family:var(--font, 'Segoe UI Variable', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Arial, sans-serif);border:0;background:none;color:var(--muted, #5b6b83);font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;padding:5px 3px;cursor:pointer;}.ds-send{display:grid;place-items:center;width:35px;height:35px;border:0;border-radius:7px;background:var(--blue, #0053fd);color:#fff;cursor:pointer;}.ds-send:hover:not(:disabled){background:#0043d3;}.ds-send:disabled{background:#d7e4fc;color:#7299dd;cursor:not-allowed;}.ds-model:focus-visible,.ds-send:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--blue, #0053fd);outline-offset:3px;}

narrative.northStar: One place to think, build, and verify.
narrative.overview:
The existing welcome phrase describes this working environment: calm, pale, and conversation oriented. White content sits alongside icy blue chrome and quieter context surfaces. Restrained functional blue directs attention to actions, selection, and focus. The user selected Hermes Desktop as an interface reference; the Windows controls and provisional JaxOS identity remain original.

This documents the implemented Windows desktop visual system, including its narrower responsive layouts. Generous central whitespace coexists with compact navigation and evidence metadata. Flat panes, quiet hairlines, and consistent line icons keep conversation, project context, and verification readable. The approved conversation and workbench compositions share this grammar; the future phone client is not yet an approved visual surface.
keyCharacteristics: Pale opaque surfaces, functional blue, and quiet hairline separation.
Segoe UI typography with a distinct monospace voice for technical evidence.
Flat navigation, conversation, context, and workbench regions.
Visible keyboard focus and state labels alongside status color.

rules.name: The Functional Accent Rule
rules.body: Use blue to identify an action, selection, or focus state. Keep the surrounding workspace pale and quiet.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Separate persistent work regions with surface tone, whitespace, and hairlines. Reserve pronounced shadows for temporary overlays.

dos: Do preserve the pale, flat desktop grammar across modes.
Do use the implemented CSS tokens when extending the interface.
Do pair status color with readable labels and recognizable icons.
Do retain visible focus, disabled states, and reduced motion support.
Do preserve readable artifact inspection with persistent zoom, fit, and close controls.
donts: Don't turn the workspace into a nested card dashboard.
Don't use the blue accent as broad decorative wallpaper.
Don't replace the Segoe UI hierarchy with an unrelated display face.
Don't show an invented passing result, connected project, or model state.
Don't treat the narrow desktop layout as an approved Android design.
